notes: CHK-006 folds the Setup-cycle conditions into the PREADY consequent. A PREADY at a Setup edge, or at the edge right after one, fails the check through the chk6_prev_setup and current-Setup terms. Helper registers reset on i_rst_n_mst only. The slv reset is added to the antecedents where the check says both resets are high. Nothing was compiled or run in Verilator.
